name: Druskenvald Dweller
summary: You hail from one of the thirteen baneful provinces of Druskenvald, whose skills and culture shaped your early life.

features.name: Home Province
features.summary: Choose your home province; it sets one extra skill and one tool.
features.text: Choose the province you come from. It decides the second skill and the tool you learned: Ardengloom (History, Herbalism Kit), Astramar (Arcana, Navigator's Tools), Bubonia (Medicine, Poisoner's Kit), Chernabos (Deception, Calligrapher's Supplies), Edwardia (Investigation, Tinker's Tools), Enoch (Nature, Leatherworker's Tools), Kalero (Performance, a Musical Instrument), Olmarsh (Arcana, Cartographer's Tools), Nerukhet (Persuasion, Weaver's Tools), Pholsense (Religion, Mason's Tools), Picco (Performance, Woodcarver's Tools), Syndramas (Athletics, Cook's Utensils), Zulrogg (Survival, Herbalism Kit). Survival comes with the background, so a Zulrogg Dweller picks any other skill. By default pick the province your species comes from.
